hooks.command: FP=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$FP" in *.env|*.env.*|*/pnpm-lock.yaml|*/db.types.ts) printf 'Blocked: %s is protected (env file / lockfile / generated Supabase types). Regenerate via '\''supabase gen types'\'' or '\''pnpm install'\'' instead of hand-editing.\n' "$FP" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
FP=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$FP" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | tail -10 || true ;; esac
